gaps.GET /v1/agent-identity/:kind/:subjectId: one agent's author, runner (workload identity, invokers), ownership flag and linked non-human identities
gaps.GET /v1/agent-identity/ownership-finding: pages agents whose owner is missing, deactivated or inactive (admin)
gaps.POST /v1/agent-identity/:kind/:subjectId: stages a cloud service account, vendor agent identity or OAuth client link for an agent (admin, audited; confers nothing)
gaps.POST /v1/agent-identity/links/:linkId/de: confirms or rejects a staged identity link (a second named admin, identity_manage step-up, audited)
